metadata.article_title: Relief to defendant where counter-claim succeeds.

article.title: Relief to defendant where counter-claim succeeds.
article.content: Where in any suit a set-off or counter-claim is established as a defence against the plaintiff’s claim and any balance is found due to the plaintiff or the defendant, as the case may be, the Court may give judgment to the party entitled to such balance.
article.html:
6FRelief to defendant where counter-claim succeeds.

Order 8, Rule 6F

Where in any suit a set-off or counter-claim is established as a defence against the plaintiff’s claim and any balance is found due to the plaintiff or the defendant, as the case may be, the Court may give judgment to the party entitled to such balance.
